# Layergram 2.0.1 — Copy and Share reliability across platforms

Layergram 2.0.1 restores generated-message Copy and Share reliability in the
shared export path used by macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and iOS. The
production incident was reproduced on macOS, where desktop-only feedback rules
also made the failure appear completely silent; the correction itself is not
macOS-only.

The release now:

- handles the missing protocol-v3 export blocker before clipboard or native
  sharing is invoked;
- shows encoding, migration, cover-capacity, clipboard, and native-sharing
  failures instead of silently returning;
- uses one guarded implementation for both compact and desktop Copy/Share
  controls;
- prevents Copy feedback from intercepting an immediate Share action; and
- adds regression coverage for direct text, cover carriers, Copy, Share,
  service failures, and a native macOS clipboard round trip.

Android open-source APKs remain signed with Layergram's dedicated direct-APK
certificate. Verify every download against the SHA-256 values published on
the Layergram website.
